int_name: N COLLEGE AVE & W COLLEGE AVE

result.summary: The environment is a mixed-use street with sidewalks present but lacking formal crossing infrastructure like marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. A large truck and parked vehicles create significant sightline obstructions at the intersection, increasing risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large box truck parked on the left side of the street completely blocks the view of pedestrians entering the roadway from that side.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations at this intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly where the large truck is currently parked.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

result.summary: The image shows a residential or institutional street with sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control at the intersection. While street trees provide a buffer, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the corner create potential visibility and crossing hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks painted crosswalks, providing no designated space or priority for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians and oncoming drivers.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, undivided roadway with sidewalks but lacks marked crossings or traffic calming infrastructure. The presence of a long, blank wall on one side and parked cars on the other creates a corridor that prioritizes vehicle movement over pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Wide unmanaged roadway
hazards.description: The broad street width without clear lane markings or traffic calming encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases pedestrian exposure time during crossings.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible for a long stretch, forcing pedestrians to cross at unmarked locations without driver warning.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use pavement markings to narrow the travel lanes, which naturally slows traffic and provides space for a buffer between the sidewalk and the road.
